scope: Read-only independent audit of affine sumR adder inventory, passive measurement and fixed-cycle sharing certificate; no repository edits

checks.original_resource_count: 17 live INT24 affine adder circuits identified from full mapped ABC9 netlist of timestamp-equivalent current baseline RTL. Normal and final-row rules share one circuit per engine. Focused noabc9 mapping is supplementary, not the final whole-baseline mapped inventory.
checks.arithmetic: Signed INT24 sumR plus sign-extended signed INT16 product; bounded sum checked with 32-bit reference and captured result.
checks.state_and_final_row: Normal row updates sumR. Final product captures sumQ data[30:7] while separately resetting sumR. Post-edge register/FIFO1 checks cover both. Stage-local sumR remains separate in sharing model.
checks.timestamps: Observer uses pre-edge cycleCnt and actual WILL_FIRE rules/productQ DEQ; post-edge capture checked on falling edge. Combinational adder request and capture occur at same recorded edge; no false multiplier-style latency.
checks.transition: Allocator requires next start >= prior capture end + 2, leaving one full idle cycle; guard is charged after every burst, including same owner. Independent checker enforces gap >= 1.
checks.allocation: Maximal consecutive same-unit operations are immutable intervals. Interval coloring is matched to sweep overlap lower bound and serialized lower-bound witness. Claim valid only for measured fixed cycles and specified reservations/guard.
checks.independent_checker: Does not import allocator; verifies every event occupies its exact serialized cycle, every reservation cycle has one event, per-stage sumR arithmetic, lane conflicts/gaps, serialized hashes and lower-bound witnesses.
checks.simultaneous_multiplier: Analyzer requires multiplier trace and inventory hashes equal prior certified 45-to-25 run and links each affine addition to earlier ordered multiplier.get through original registered two-entry productQ. Both resource pools preserve original event times.
checks.netlist_mapping: Local Yosys synth_lattice help and focused noabc9 log place sharing/optimization and CCU2 arithmetic mapping before ABC/ABC9 LUT selection. No concrete differing-count mechanism identified for these distinct live affine operands.

claim_limits: This is a trace-derived resource schedule, not implemented shared RTL.
Shared mux/control/routing area and final shared physical timing are unmeasured.
No arbitrary-workload optimum or net FPGA area saving established.

corrected_findings.finding: Observer kernel-check evidence label inherited Icarus although commands executed Verilator.
corrected_findings.resolution: Metadata-only label correction. Exact executed script/report retained as run_executed.py and validation_executed.json; corrected script explicitly marked not rerun. No result data changed.

runtime_evidence.minimum_scope: For these fixed operation/capture cycles and one addition per adder per cycle, 13 actual concurrent additions impose a lower bound of 13. Verified schedule attains 13 while also leaving the required transition gap.
